_meta.description: Superseded-artifact registry. Each entry tracks a result JSON (raw log, aggregate, or derived) that is referenced by ci/claim_data_ties.json (L15 numerical-claim checks). status values: current | supplementary_only | reviewer_evidence | superseded | deprecated. Before marking any artifact superseded, update superseded_by and ensure no L15 entry still binds to the old path (artifact_registry_check.py enforces this). raw_inputs is null everywhere because the repo does not retain raw API-response archives; this is noted per entry.
